content: ऊर्ध्व {%a.%} Erect, upright, above; ˚केश <ab>&c.</ab>; rising or tending upwards. .²2 Raised, elevated, erected; ˚हस्तः, ˚पादः <ab>&c.</ab> .²3 High, superior, upper. .²4 Not sitting (<ab>opp.</ab> आसीन). .²5 Torn (as hair). .²6 Thrown up. .{@-र्ध्वम्@} Elevation, height. .{@-र्ध्वम्@} --{%ind.%} .²1 Upwards, aloft, above. अधश्चोर्ध्वं च प्रसृतम् <ls>Muṇḍ. 2. 2. 11</ls>; अधश्चोर्ध्वं प्रसृतास्तस्य शाखाः <ls>Bg. 15. 1</ls>. .²2 In the sequel (= उपरिष्टात्). .²3 In a high tone, aloud. .²4 Afterwards, subsequent to (with <ab>abl.</ab>); शरीरभेदादूर्ध्वमुत्क्रम्य पुनः <ls>Ait. Up. 4. 6</ls>. ते त्र्यहादूर्ध्वमाख्याय <ls>Ku. 6. 93</ls>; ऊर्ध्वं संवत्सरात् <ls>Ms. 9. 77</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 53</ls>; <ls>R. 14. 66</ls>; <ls>Bk. 18. 36</ls>; पितुरूर्ध्वम् <ls>Ms. 9. 104</ls> after the fatherʼs death; अत ऊर्ध्वम् hence forward, hereafter.
